personality_one_liner: Un'esperienza tenera, romantica e giocosa che trasforma l'attesa in una magica e morbida sorpresa color pastello.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Elements should feel like soft touchable objects. Ensure padding around cards and buttons is comfortable.

do's: Use subtle glassmorphism on the sticky bottom CTA container to let scrolling content peek through
Use soft frosted overlays for modal entries or loading state backdrops
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs that muddy the pastel palette
Do not use glass on form inputs or main photo upload cards

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Accoglienza emozionale. Introduce la magia dell'app con una grafica romantica e un pulsante per iniziare.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top (dreamy couple/magic vibe) spanning 50% of the screen with a bottom-to-top gradient scrim. Below it, large Fredoka display title ('Crea la vostra magia'), soft Nunito subtitle. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom ('Inizia').

screens.name: Upload
screens.purpose: Raccolta delle foto dei genitori e preferenze (genere).

states.empty: Mostra slot vuoti per Papà e Mamma con icona fotocamera morbida
states.error: Messaggio di errore se foto non valida, posizionato sotto lo slot.

screens.layout: Scrollable single column. Two large, chunky, rounded cards for photo uploads (surfaceSecondary with shadow 2). When empty, show brandTertiary tinted icon containers. Below photos, a segmented control/pill toggles for gender ('Maschio', 'Femmina', 'Sorprendimi'). Bottom fixed container with glassmorphism holding the primary 'Genera' CTA.

screens.name: Generating
screens.purpose: Schermata di attesa magica durante la chiamata AI.

states.loading: Fullscreen animated state con particelle/cuori e testo 'La cicogna è in viaggio...'

screens.layout: Flex-1 centered layout, warm pastel surfaceTertiary background. Central animated illustration (magic sparkles/hearts) and loading text. No header.

screens.name: Result
screens.purpose: Mostra il risultato (figlio) con azioni per salvare o condividere.
screens.layout: Large hero image of the generated 2-5yo child (shadow 2, rounded lg). Below it, celebratory text. Grid of secondary actions (Salva in Galleria, Condividi, Riprova) using tactile pill buttons.

welcome_hero.alt: Coppia romantica che scatta un selfie al tramonto

result_placeholder.alt: Bambino adorabile e realistico con sfondo pastello

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT' personality: chunky, touchable UI, oversized tap targets, and no harsh borders.
Use 'Fredoka' for all headings and large buttons, and 'Nunito' for body/labels to maintain the friendly, soft vibe.
The palette relies on romantic pastel pinks and purples as explicitly requested in the brief. Ensure high contrast for text (use onBrandPrimary/onSurface) against pastel backgrounds.

Implementation note for photo upload: Since Expo image picker is used, ensure the empty state of the dropzones features a tactile icon (Ionicons 'camera' or 'heart') in a `brandTertiary` tinted circle.
The sticky 'Genera' CTA on the Upload screen must live outside the scroll view with a glass background or subtle gradient fade to let the user scroll past the photo cards freely.
Result Screen actions should be presented as playful pill buttons (e.g., 'Salva' primary, 'Condividi' secondary, 'Riprova' ghost).
Ensure all text is in Italian as per the user's explicit request.
